content.short: NALA is an African-focused remittance app and multi-currency account for diaspora and cross-border payments.
content.description: NALA is a global multi-currency account and remittance app focused on Africa and other emerging markets, helping people in the diaspora send money home and letting businesses move money across the continent. Its consumer app enables fast, low-cost transfers from the UK, US, Europe and Asia to bank accounts and mobile-money wallets across Tanzania, Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana and beyond, with transparent rates. Beyond consumer remittances, NALA runs Rafiki, its own payments infrastructure that powers business payouts and collections across more than 35 countries. Backed by Y Combinator and named to the Forbes Fintech 50, it has more than a million users.
content.meta: NALA is an African remittance app and payments platform for people and businesses. Discover NALA and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
